arxiv-2012-13944.title: ROS for Human-Robot Interaction
arxiv-2012-13944.creator: Youssef Mohamed, Séverin Lemaignan
arxiv-2012-13944.description: Abstract Integrating real-time, complex social signal processing into robotic systems – especially in real-world, multi-party interaction situations – is a challenge faced by many in the Human-Robot Interaction (HRI) community. The difficulty is compounded by the lack of any standard model for human representation that would facilitate the development and interoperability of social perception components and pipelines.

arxiv-2305-02938.title: Off-Road Navigation of Legged Robots Using Linear Transfer Operators footnoteinfo This work was supported by the NSF under grant 2031573, 1932458, and 1942523.
arxiv-2305-02938.creator: Joseph Moyalan, Andrew Zheng, Sriram S.K.S Narayanan, Umesh Vaidya
arxiv-2305-02938.description: Abstract This paper presents the implementation of off-road navigation on legged robots using convex optimization through linear transfer operators. Given a traversability measure that captures the off-road environment, we lift the navigation problem into the density space using the Perron-Frobenius (P-F) operator. This allows the problem formulation to be represented as a convex optimization.

arxiv-2401-14556.title: Looking Right is Sometimes Right: Investigating the Capabilities of Decoder-only LLMs for Sequence Labeling
arxiv-2401-14556.creator: David DukićJan ŠnajderTakeLab, Faculty of Electrical Engineering and Computing, University of Zagreb {david.dukic, jan.snajder}@fer.hr
arxiv-2401-14556.description: Abstract Pre-trained language models based on masked language modeling (MLM) excel in natural language understanding (NLU) tasks. While fine-tuned MLM-based encoders consistently outperform causal language modeling decoders of comparable size, recent decoder-only large language models (LLMs) perform on par with smaller MLM-based encoders.

arxiv-2403-03837.title: An Adaptive Multivariate Functional EWMA Control Chart
arxiv-2403-03837.creator: Christian Capezza, Giovanna Capizzi, Fabio Centofanti, Antonio Lepore, Biagio Palumbo
arxiv-2403-03837.description: Abstract In many modern industrial scenarios, the measurements of the quality characteristics of interest are often required to be represented as functional data or profiles. This motivates the growing interest in extending traditional univariate statistical process monitoring (SPM) schemes to the functional data setting.

arxiv-2501-05832.title: Channel deformations during elastocapillary spreading of gaseous embolisms in biomimetic leaves. Preprint: Subm. to INTERFACE FOCUS. IUTAM: Capillarity and Elastocapillarity in Biology special issue.
arxiv-2501-05832.creator: François-Xavier Gauci, Ludovic Jami, Ludovic Keiser, Celine Cohen, Xavier Noblin
arxiv-2501-05832.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by François-Xavier Gauci, Ludovic Jami, Ludovic Keiser, Celine Cohen, Xavier Noblin. The nucleation and/or spreading of bubbles in water under tension (due to water evaporation) can be problematic for most plants along the ascending sap network from root to leaves, named xylem. Due to global warming, trees facing drought conditions are particularly threatened by the formation of such air embolisms, which spreads intermittently and hinder the flow of sap and could ultimately result in their demise.

arxiv-2509-18377.title: Interactive Real-Time Speaker Diarization Correction with Human Feedback
arxiv-2509-18377.creator: Xinlu He, Yiwen Guan, Badrivishal Paurana, Zilin Dai, and Jacob Whitehill
arxiv-2509-18377.description: Abstract Most automatic speech processing systems operate in “open loop” mode without user feedback about who said what, yet human-in-the-loop workflows can potentially enable higher accuracy. We propose an LLM-assisted speaker diarization correction system that lets users fix speaker attribution errors in real time.

arxiv-2602-04181.title: Piece of CAKE : Adaptive Execution Engines via Microsecond-Scale Learning
arxiv-2602-04181.creator: Zijie Zhao, Ryan Marcus
arxiv-2602-04181.description: Abstract . Low-level database operators often admit multiple physical implementations (“kernels”) that are semantically equivalent but have vastly different performance characteristics depending on the input data distribution. Existing database systems typically rely on static heuristics or worst-case optimal defaults to select these kernels, often missing significant performance opportunities.

pmc-10531331.title: Association of Cognitive Polygenic Index and Cognitive Performance with Age in Cognitively Healthy Adults
pmc-10531331.creator: Angeliki Tsapanou, Margaret Gacheru, Seonjoo Lee, Niki Mourtzi, Yunglin Gazes, Christian Habeck, Daniel W. Belsky, Yaakov Stern
pmc-10531331.description: Genome-wide association studies have discovered common genetic variants associated with cognitive performance. Polygenic scores that summarize these discoveries explain up to 10% of the variance in cognitive test performance in samples of adults. However, the role these genetics play in cognitive aging is not well understood.

pmc-11516629.title: An evaluation of the first ten years of Newborn Screening for cystic fibrosis in Ireland
pmc-11516629.creator: F McGuire, B Linnane, A Collins, P Marsden
pmc-11516629.description: Ireland has the world’s highest incidence of cystic fibrosis (CF). Newborn screening for CF (NBSCF) improves outcomes but identifies carriers and may yield false positive/inconclusive results. This study aimed to evaluate the performance of the first 10 years of the Irish NBSCF programme.

pmc-11587102.title: 2024 Update on Position Statement by Experts from the Polish Society of Allergology and the Polish Respiratory Society on the Evaluation of Efficacy and Effectiveness of Single Inhaler Triple Therapies in Asthma Treatment
pmc-11587102.creator: Paweł Śliwiński, Adam Antczak, Adam Barczyk, Adam J Białas, Małgorzata Czajkowska-Malinowska, Karina Jahnz-Różyk, Marek Kulus, Piotr Kuna, Maciej Kupczyk, Padukudru Anand Mahesh
pmc-11587102.description: Highlights What are the main findings? Inhaled triple-combination medications, ICS/LABA/LAMA, within a singular inhalation device yield a dual benefit of minimizing the likelihood of adverse effects linked with the principal therapeutic agent for asthma management, namely ICS, while concurrently optimizing bronchodilator efficacy.SITT therapy has the potential to enhance asthma symptom management and postpone the requirement for initiating biologic therapy.

pmc-13295814.title: Corchorus olitorius L. Protects Zebrafish Hair Cells Against Cisplatin-Induced Damage via Antioxidant and Anti-Apoptotic Mechanisms
pmc-13295814.creator: Wei-Sheng Wen, Hsin-Lin Cheng, Zheng-Qi He, Ming-Wei Lee, Yu-Xuan Wu, Tzu-Huan Hung, Shang-Ting Tsai, Po-Hui Wang, Jiann-Jou Yang
pmc-13295814.description: Cisplatin is a widely used platinum-based chemotherapeutic agent that often causes irreversible hair cell loss, leading to hearing impairment. To date, effective strategies for preventing cisplatin-induced ototoxicity remain limited. Corchorus olitorius L. (COL) is rich in bioactive phytochemicals with antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties; however, the protective role of COL stem against cisplatin-induced hearing loss has not been explored.

pmc-13378694.title: Anode‐Free All‐Solid‐State Batteries: Understanding Limitations and Charting a Path to Enhanced Performance
pmc-13378694.creator: Sion Kim, Jaechan Lee, Jihyun Jang
pmc-13378694.description: All‐solid‐state batteries (ASSBs) utilizing sulfide solid‐state electrolytes (SSEs) emerge as the most promising platform for next‐generation, high‐energy‐density systems, owing to the exceptional ionic conductivity of SSEs. To maximize energy density, anode‐free ASSBs involving direct Li plating and stripping onto the current collector are actively explored.

pmc-13586828.title: Diffuse midline glioma, H3 K27-altered, forming a suprasellar mass: A case report
pmc-13586828.creator: Rihito Nakazato, Tetsuya Shimizu, Akihiko Teshigawara, Miku Fukasawa, Akira Baba, Satoshi Matsushima, Taku Gomi, Mayuko Terayama, Ai Iwauchi, Nei Fukasawa, Toshihide Tanaka, Hiroya Ojiri
pmc-13586828.description: Diffuse midline glioma, H3 K27-altered (DMG), is an extremely aggressive tumor that mainly arises in midline structures such as the thalamus, brainstem, and spinal cord in children and young adults. We report a rare adult case of DMG presenting as a suprasellar mass. A 56-year-old man presented with progressive visual impairment over 2 months.
